provenance: Primary AWS documentation plus explicitly local compatibility rules. No live AWS execution.

local_rules.defaulted_part_integrity: Verify request algorithm independently; persist and return immutable CRC64NVME part digest. Never infer initiation from first part. Explicit upload mismatches fail.
local_rules.range_qualification: Binary threshold and exact error projection provisional; primary source only says 5 MB.
local_rules.copy_tags_with_copy_directive: Reject supplied tags; REPLACE omission means empty.
local_rules.completion: Do not ignore legacy supplied checksum assertions. Initiation tags require no extra completion tag grant.
